spans.s: †धव् धवते run, flow. — अव flow down, descend.

2 धाव् धा॑वति धा॑व˚ते pp. दौत॑ (q.v.) rinse,
wash, cleanse, purify;
 M. also refl. C धाव॑यति wash. — आ knead,
press out, cleanse (esp. the Soma-stems). नि M. rub or anoint one's
self;
 rub one's self against i.e. cling to (loc.). प्र rub off, C.
wash. वि wash or cleanse off. सम् M. run or wash one's self. — Cf.
निर्दौत, विदौत.
1 धव॑ m. N. of a plant.
2 धव m. man, husband, master, lord.

धवल (f. आ & ई) white;
 abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
धवलगिरि m. N. of a mountain.
धवलाय् धवला˚यति become or shine white.
3 धावक m. N. of a poet.

1 धावन n. running, galloping;
 onset, assault.
